text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, I've really done it now...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, rather than a problem,
it's more like I made a bit of a blunder...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
When I was trying to wash Tama-chan's track jacket,
I accidentally put bleach in by mistake.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This normally never happens to me.
And yet, look at me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan just laughed it off and forgave me,
saying, "What are ya doin'?!" but still...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
How could I have made such a blunder...
*sigh*
